auditTarget: Identified security gaps and residual risks

gaps.title: Unvalidated Caller Execution Context
gaps.description: The sealBinding() method accepts an executionContext string from the caller which is implicitly trusted. While this string is protected by the HMAC once issued, an untrusted module in the same process can request a seal for any context (e.g., 'MULTIDOMAIN_PCB') and it will be granted.
gaps.mitigation: Implement caller identity verification (e.g., via module path inspection or explicit caller registration) if fine-grained execution context authorization is required.
